summary: 1950s firefinder platform and trailer quarters on Lincoln County's north coast; gone by 1959, and no source describes remains or access.

facts.status_note: Platform and trailer quarters gone by 1959; no source describes what remains.

events.note: Sources give only 'the 1950s'; 1950 is a decade placeholder, not a documented date.
Both sources say the platform and trailer quarters were gone by 1959; no exact removal date is given.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: both lookout sources restate one short description (1950s platform and trailer quarters, gone by 1959). No staffing, access, visit or remains information was found, so those keys are omitted. Brief elevation 342.9 m matches the register's 343 m and firelookout's 1,125 ft. Coordinates match the register. Wikipedia is used only for the firefinder definition. An anyplaceamerica summit listing for 'Gobblers Knob' in Lincoln County returned HTTP 403 and was not used, so it is unconfirmed whether that summit is this site.
